AC amendment (gap analysis): Task-1 creates only .sh/.json/.md files (no Python). Scope the lint/format ACs to actual changed files instead of the generic Python glob:
  Verify: git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM HEAD | grep -E '\.py$' | xargs -r ruff check
  Verify: git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM HEAD | grep -E '\.py$' | xargs -r ruff format --check
This prevents false-failure on unrelated pre-existing Python lint issues on main.
